description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ganangolla (Block 01) Thamankaduwa D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120291
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title settlement processes, cadastral maps, and property ownership claims across multiple districts. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title determination, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as defined by the classification criteria for land and property-related matters.
